versions.changelog:
Initial release of Experiment Designer.

- Generates complete, statistically sound A/B test designs or thorough results interpretations.
- Guides users to provide essential inputs: hypothesis, baseline metrics, MDE, sample size, or results data.
- Outputs include hypothesis restatement, clearly defined metrics, sample size/run time estimates, and explicit success criteria.
- Flags common experiment risks (e.g., early stopping, novelty effects, sample ratio mismatch).
- Separates statistical from practical significance and gives a clear Ship/Iterate/Kill/Follow-up recommendation.
- Emphasizes rigor: disallows post-hoc success criteria, early peeking, and multiple uncorrected primary metrics.
